qa_pair.question: Scan this Python for SQL injection: `query = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = '" + user_input + "'"; cursor.execute(query)`
qa_pair.answer: altais_scan_code detects an injection finding (SQL query built by string concatenation of untrusted input) at high/critical severity, citing CWE-89.

qa_pair.question: Does this JavaScript have an XSS issue? `document.getElementById('out').innerHTML = location.hash;`
qa_pair.answer: altais_scan_code reports an XSS finding for assigning untrusted input (`location.hash`) into `innerHTML`, citing CWE-79.

qa_pair.question: Scan this Node code for SSRF: `const url = req.query.target; fetch(url);`
qa_pair.answer: altais_scan_code reports a server-side request forgery (SSRF) finding because a user-controlled value is passed directly to `fetch`, citing CWE-918.

qa_pair.answer: altais_scan_code reports a path-traversal finding because untrusted input is used to build a filesystem path, citing CWE-22.
